prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1111; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was turning left across the lanes when another car hit my passenger side.
Q: What was the traffic signal doing when you started the turn?
A: The light had turned yellow, and I thought I had time to clear it. Looking back, I probably should have waited.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I checked for oncoming traffic, saw nothing close, and then I heard the horn and felt the hit.
Q: How fast were you going?
A: Slowly, maybe just starting to pick up speed through the turn.
Q: Were you hurt at the scene?
A: My neck was stiff right away, but I didn't think much of it. By that evening the pain had spread into my upper shoulders and I had trouble turning my head to check mirrors.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?
A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic and was told I had a neck strain. I've been doing home exercises and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Some days are better than others. Driving longer than twenty minutes still bothers me.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm willing to provide my medical paperwork once I receive it. Thank you.
